label: Resonance
role: To select a representation of the knot group and assign the Factor’s principal quantum numbers (n, m) and phase character.
definition: Resonance is the acoustic shadow of the complement’s orbifold geometry. The integers n (quantum depth, from cone point 19) and m (harmonic complexity, from cone point 2) parametrise a flat U(1) representation of π₁(S³ \ T(19,2)). The phase factor φ = exp(2πi (n/19 + m/2)) is the character of this representation. Conditions n/19 + m/2 = 0, 1, 1/2 correspond respectively to pure potential (phase π), full actualisation (phase 0), and transitional processing. Hamiltonian interpretation: (n,m) are action quantum numbers of a two‑mode harmonic oscillator on the resonance torus; φ is the time‑evolution phase. Default class: torus; satellite and hyperbolic placeholders exist for future extension.
manifestation: A Factor with n=2, m=4 yields φ = e^(2πi(2/19+4/2)) = e^(2πi(8/19)), a complex phase. Its narrative depth is groupoid‑level (characters aware of multiple interpretations) and it carries up to 4 parallel subplots.

torus.description: For T(p,q) knots, here p=19, q=2.

hamiltonian_view: Action quantum numbers: I_19 = n, I_2 = m; total action S = 2π(19n + 2m). Phase φ is the unitary time evolution operator at a chosen reference time.
